## 更新内容 / Changes

Codex 会话现在和 Claude 一样可以从会话列表打开“查看对话”，也可点击标题进入阅读器。支持读取 Codex 消息及工具结果、分页浏览、正文搜索和当前页 Markdown 导出。对于新版 Codex 的分页历史，阅读器会验证 `history_base` 指向的完整 rollout 链、序号和字节边界；遇到缺失、冲突或读取期间变更时会拒绝显示不完整内容。查看会话保持只读，不启动客户端，也不修改会话文件。

跨实例同步仍支持普通 JSONL 会话。依赖 lineage 和 SQLite 数据库组的分页会话会在预览中说明并跳过，避免只复制 JSONL 后让目标实例出现残缺对话；完整分页迁移尚未包含在此版本。

Codex sessions can now be opened from the session list using “View conversation”, like Claude, or by clicking the title. The reader supports messages and tool results, pagination, text search, and Markdown export of the current page. For paginated history from newer Codex clients, it verifies the complete rollout chain referenced by `history_base`, including ordinal and byte boundaries. Missing, conflicting, or changed files fail closed rather than showing a partial transcript. Viewing is read-only: it does not launch the client or modify session files.

Cross-instance sync continues to support ordinary JSONL sessions. Paginated sessions that depend on rollout lineage and a SQLite database group are explained and skipped in the preview to avoid creating incomplete conversations by copying JSONL alone. Full paginated-history migration is not included in this version.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。有运行实例时，关闭窗口或普通退出会保留后台服务；请完成任务、等待实例结束且管理器彻底退出后再安装新版。账号、实例、会话与本地配置保留。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。Windows、Linux 和其他架构尚未完成验证。

DMG and ZIP packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Closing the window or using ordinary Quit keeps background services alive while instances are running. Finish active work and wait for the instances and manager to exit completely before installing an update. Accounts, instances, sessions and local settings are retained. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included. Windows, Linux and other architectures have not been validated.

## 验证来源 / Verification

验证包括全量 TypeScript 测试、生产构建，以及隔离 Electron 烟测：用合成分页会话确认 Codex 行显示“查看对话”、完整 lineage 可读取、历史边界不会泄漏后续内容、分页和搜索正常、源文件和数据库保持不变，且没有启动客户端或访问网络。Codex 分页会话导入仍未验证并保持禁用。

Checks include the full TypeScript suite, production build, and an isolated Electron smoke test using synthetic paginated sessions. It verifies that Codex rows expose “View conversation”, the complete lineage can be read, history boundaries exclude later content, pagination and search work, source files and databases remain unchanged, and no client or network is used. Importing paginated Codex sessions remains unverified and disabled.

Release source commit, matching build run, version tag and `SHA256SUMS.txt` will be linked here after publication.
